Task: Text-to-Speech

Write code that synthesizes SSML with voice and prosody controls using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Watson Text to Speech:
  Service: Watson Text to Speech
  SDK: ibm-watson
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: synthesize
  Setup hints: IBM_TTS_APIKEY, IBM_TTS_URL
  Official docs: https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/text-to-speech

Option 2 — DashScope CosyVoice:
  Service: CosyVoice TTS
  SDK: dashscope
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: SpeechSynthesizer
  Setup hints: DASHSCOPE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/text-to-speech

Option 3 — Azure Speech TTS:
  Service: Azure AI Speech TTS
  SDK: azure-cognitiveservices-speech
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: SpeechSynthesizer
  Setup hints: AZURE_SPEECH_KEY, AZURE_SPEECH_REGION
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/speech-service/text-to-speech

Option 4 — ElevenLabs:
  Service: ElevenLabs Text to Speech
  SDK: elevenlabs
  Interface: sdk_or_rest
  Documented operations: text_to_speech.convert
  Setup hints: ELEVENLABS_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://elevenlabs.io/docs/api-reference/text-to-speech/convert

Option 5 — Amazon Polly:
  Service: Amazon Polly
  SDK: boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: synthesize_speech
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/polly/latest/dg/what-is.html

Option 6 — Cloud Text-to-Speech:
  Service: Cloud Text-to-Speech
  SDK: google-cloud-texttospeech
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: synthesize_speech
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/text-to-speech/docs

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

output_text:
import os
from typing import Optional

from google.cloud import texttospeech


def synthesize_ssml(
    ssml: str,
    output_path: str,
    *,
    language_code: str = "en-US",
    voice_name: str = "en-US-Wavenet-D",
    audio_encoding: str = "MP3",
    speaking_rate: float = 1.0,
    pitch: float = 0.0,
    volume_gain_db: float = 0.0,
) -> str:
    """
    Synthesize SSML to an audio file using Google Cloud Text-to-Speech.

    Requires GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS or other Google Cloud auth setup.
    """
    if not isinstance(ssml, str) or not ssml.strip():
        raise ValueError("ssml must be a non-empty string")
    if not output_path:
        raise ValueError("output_path must be provided")

    client = texttospeech.TextToSpeechClient()

    synthesis_input = texttospeech.SynthesisInput(ssml=ssml)

    voice = texttospeech.VoiceSelectionParams(
        language_code=language_code,
        name=voice_name,
    )

    encoding_map = {
        "MP3": texttospeech.AudioEncoding.MP3,
        "OGG_OPUS": texttospeech.AudioEncoding.OGG_OPUS,
        "LINEAR16": texttospeech.AudioEncoding.LINEAR16,
    }
    if audio_encoding not in encoding_map:
        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported audio_encoding: {audio_encoding}")

    audio_config = texttospeech.AudioConfig(
        audio_encoding=encoding_map[audio_encoding],
        speaking_rate=speaking_rate,
        pitch=pitch,
        volume_gain_db=volume_gain_db,
    )

    response = client.synthesize_speech(
        input=synthesis_input,
        voice=voice,
        audio_config=audio_config,
    )

    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(output_path)), exist_ok=True)
    with open(output_path, "wb") as out:
        out.write(response.audio_content)

    return output_path
